name: Should I choose porcelain, ceramic, or stone for my shower tile?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose porcelain, ceramic, or stone for my shower tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain is often the strongest all-around choice for shower walls and floors because it handles moisture well and is durable. Ceramic can work well for walls, while natural stone can look high-end but usually needs more maintenance and sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain is usually the safest all-around shower choice, ceramic works well on walls, and stone needs more care. The right option depends on your budget, style, and how much maintenance you want.
